updateLog.en:
1. Added native support for Via version 7.4.1
2. Added list search functionality
3. Added scheduled refresh functionality
4. Added a feature where the long-press menu always expands downward
5. Added an information screen
6. Expanded the scope for removing whitelist restrictions
7. Rewrote the Cookie Manager to significantly improve performance
8. Rewrote code for various features to reduce stuttering and frame drops
9. Updated some interfaces to match the new UI
10. Added support for searching settings in the latest version of Via
11. Optimized page animation adaptation
12. Fixed several issues
